chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, raising it, said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Do not perform salat (prayer) in that which is transparent or clear,” meaning the polished garment.
Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: And it is disliked for him to wear the waist-wrapper over the shirt during salat (prayer).

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ الْمُصَقَّلَ: The polished garment; a smooth or lustrous cloth that may reveal what is beneath.
key_terms.شَفَّ: Became transparent; referring to clothing through which the body may be seen.
key_terms.صَفَّ: Became clear or thin in appearance; indicating revealing clothing.
key_terms.لَا تُصَلِّ: Do not perform salat (prayer); a prohibition regarding prayer in a certain state or garment.

ai.seo_question: What kind of clothing is not allowed or disliked in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding clothing worn in salat (prayer), prohibiting prayer in a garment that is transparent or overly revealing. It also adds that wearing a waist-wrapper over a shirt in prayer is disliked, reflecting attention to proper dress and decorum in worship.
